Yuki was verbally, emotionally, and especially psychologically mistreated by Akito; he was locked up in a windowless, dark room for days on end while Akito convinced him that no one would accept him for who he is, that he was absolutely worthless and that no one would ever come to save him. During this time, Yuki accidentally revealed his Zodiac form to outsiders, and thus had to get his friend’s memories of him erased. After this, Yuki asked Akito if he truly was so strange that he had to keep the Curse a secret, to which Akito replied that he did have to, since it was strange for a little boy to transform into a rat. She also told him that any normal person would be repulsed if they knew.

entries.name: Akito Sohma: Pre-Fruits Basket
entries.content:
Pre-Fruits Basket

For the following years, Akito kept Kureno by her side at all times, even starting a sexual relationship with him. Shigure became incredibly jealous by this and proceeded to have sex with Ren as a form of revenge. This made Akito even more infuriated, and she thus banished Shigure from the Sohma estate as a punishment.


Akito attacked Kana: Throughout the years, Akito has been desperate to prove Ren wrong, and that her bonds with the Zodiacs were indeed real. Because of this, she continued to torment Yuki and often restricted him from doing anything she didn’t want him to do. Akito also began hating women since she projected her own mother onto them, and thus became incredibly violent with women who took the male Zodiac’s attention away from her. For example, she beat Kisa Sohma bloody after Hiro Sohma confessed his feelings towards Kisa to Akito, leaving Kisa to recover in the hospital for two weeks. After Hatori and his then fianceé, Kana Sohma, asked Akito to let them marry, Akito was enraged and almost blinded Hatori's left eye with a shard glass. To make matters worse, Akito berated Kana for Hatori's injuries and guilt-tripped her into believing that wanting to marry Hatori was a mistake she should have never made since she is incapable of lifting the family curse. After Hatori was forced to erase Kana's memories of their time together as a couple, Akito suggested for him to abstain from interacting with her ever again.

Yuki was eventually able to leave the main house and began living with Shigure. Ren commented that the Zodiacs were abandoning Akito, just as she always predicted they would. Akito denied this and claimed they would all come back to her because of the inseparable bond she shared with the Zodiacs. Akito and Ren then made a bet in which Akito was to allow the Zodiacs to form bonds with "outsiders" to test whether they would return to Akito's side. If they did not return, Akito would have to bow before Ren and then leave the Sohma family.

A few months later, Akito somehow found out that Isuzu Sohma and Hatsuharu Sohma were dating one another. She confronted Rin and threatened her to answer which one had seduced the other, and Rin put the blame on herself. This made Akito furious and she proceeded to slap Rin and berated her for taking what’s “hers”, all while reaffirming that she hates women. She then told Rin that she is not worthy of Hatsuharu, that she only exists to make up numbers in the Zodiac, and that she isn’t needed— thereafter pushing Rin out of a window some stories above the ground.


Akito making a bet with Kyo: After Kyo returned from the mountains after being away for four months without any notice, Akito severely reprimanded him. She also told him that due to the Zodiac’s fates always being in their blood, Kyo could thus never beat Yuki no matter how much he tried. However, Kyo swore that he would beat Yuki, and as a response, Akito made a bet with him; if he could beat Yuki before graduating high school, she would stop calling him a monster and he could become a full-fledged member of the Zodiac. If he couldn’t succeed, however, he needed to spend the rest of his life in the Cat's Room, to which Kyo accepted. When Shigure later asked Akito if he could let both Kyo and Tohru Honda to live with him at his house, she accepted, since she was confident that she would win her bet against Ren.

entries.name: Akito Sohma: First Year Arc
entries.content:
First Year Arc

Akito agrees to let Tohru stay at Shigure's house: After making the bet with Kyo, Shigure approached Akito about allowing Tohru to stay in his home. Akito, confident that she would win against Ren, consented to this. Since Akito believed that the world was a cruel, bleak place in which unconditional love did not exist outside of the Zodiac bonds, she also believed that Tohru would eventually end up rejecting the cursed Sohmas, causing them to return brokenhearted to her side.

When Tohru leaves the Sohmas' main house after her first visit to there, Akito is seen gloomily staring out of a window at Tohru. Tohru spotted her and got frightened by the gloomy hated aura from Akito.
